tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, the lower part of the screen gradient.

tokens.name: bg-glow
tokens.usage: Top of the screen gradient: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%, bg-glow, bg 55%). Never a flat fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Hero card, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: surface-row
tokens.usage: Category rows, transaction rows, option cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Bar tracks, segmented-control well, inputs, bottom bar.

tokens.name: surface-edge
tokens.usage: The solid bottom edge under every pressable surface (see shadow tokens).

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: 2px border on rows and cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on bg, surface, surface-row and surface-sunken (13.7:1 night, 16:1 day on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-row (7.7:1 night, 7:1 day on surface).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the ＋ button, selected states. White text on it: 4.8:1 night, 5.6:1 day.

tokens.name: brand-glow
tokens.usage: Top highlight of brand fills and the soft glow behind the primary button. Decorative; never under text.

tokens.name: brand-edge
tokens.usage: Solid bottom edge of brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with 2px offset (14.6:1 on night bg, 6.3:1 on day bg).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: What is left: the hero amount, bars in the ok state. Text-safe on surface in both themes (12.3:1 night, 5.4:1 day).

tokens.name: near
tokens.usage: Near the limit (80 % or more spent): bar fill and its 'Quedan' line. Always paired with words, never color alone.

tokens.name: over
tokens.usage: Over budget: bar fill and 'Te pasaste X' line. Always paired with words.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Lukas, the logo gradient start, celebration sparkles, the active tab label (night).

tokens.name: candy
tokens.usage: Logo gradient end and celebration confetti. Decorative only.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one hero figure per screen: what is left this month.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen and sheet titles, landing headlines (scale up to 40px on desktop).

styles.name: amount-row
styles.usage: Amounts in transaction rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary and secondary button labels, uppercase.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The wordmark, filled with the gold → candy gradient.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Registra en segundos y mira en qué se va cada luka.
styles.usage: Running text. Nunito is set heavy on purpose; never below 600.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row status lines, helper text, meta.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between a caption and its bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row and card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Landing sections on phone; double it on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Category icon tiles, keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segmented control, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rows, the ＋ button.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero card, sheets, primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges (PENDIENTE), the month pill, bars.

shadow.note: Depth is a solid bottom edge, not a blur. Pressing moves the element down by the edge height and collapses the edge.

tokens.name: edge-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, chips, the month pill. Pressed: translateY(3px), edge 0 1px 0.

tokens.name: edge-md
tokens.usage: Hero card, keypad keys, option cards.

tokens.name: edge-brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the ＋ button. Pressed: translateY(5px), 0 1px 0 brand-edge.

duration.note: Timing values for the feedback events. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: keep only fades.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Press down and release of any pressable.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet open and close.

tokens.name: count-up
tokens.usage: Hero amount counting to its new value after a save.

tokens.name: celebrate
tokens.usage: The ¡Anotado! celebration before the toast settles.
